questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: Why celebrities deny having had cosmetic procedures done
The rising popularity, risks and realities of eyelid surgery
How to treat dry eyes and swelling after facial surgery
The soaring cost of weight-loss drugs and their side effects
questions.explain: It covers growing blepharoplasty demand along with its risks, limits and what patients should consider.

questions.q: In 2022, eyelid surgery replaced which procedure as the most popular facial cosmetic surgery?
options: Facelift
Botox injections
Brow lift
Rhinoplasty
questions.explain: Blepharoplasty replaced rhinoplasty, the nose job, as the most popular facial cosmetic surgery.

questions.q: What does Dr. Kazim ask younger patients to gauge whether they are ready?
options: Whether they have already tried Botox or fillers
Whether their budget covers possible revision surgery
How long they have been thinking about the surgery
Whether they have recently lost weight with medication
questions.explain: A long time considering it suggests they weighed the risks and are not acting impulsively.

questions.q: How long did Dr. Patel recommend people wait after significant weight loss before an aesthetic procedure?
options: At least three months
At least one month
At least two years
At least six months
questions.explain: He recommended waiting at least six months after significant weight loss.

questions.q: What would the article's experts most likely say about before-and-after photos online?
options: They show typical outcomes for the average patient
They are the best guide to the results you can expect
They are reliable whenever they come from celebrities
They may be edited and set unrealistic expectations
questions.explain: Dr. Basu said online photos can be digitally enhanced or AI-manipulated, leading to unrealistic expectations.
